chapter_description.p: The Test Manager module in Nelson provides tools for automated testing of code, enabling users to validate functionality, ensure correctness, and manage test cases efficiently.
This module supports creating reference outputs, running test suites, and conditionally skipping tests.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.assume
keyword.description: Skip a test when a runtime assumption is not satisfied.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.discover
keyword.description: Discover test files and return a structured suite.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.makeref
keyword.description: Create a reference file for a test.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.plan
keyword.description: Create an execution plan for a test suite.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.report
keyword.description: Write test and benchmark runner reports.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.run
keyword.description: Run tests through the modern test runner.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.tuneReuse
keyword.description: Calibrate explicit child-process reuse for tests and benches.

keyword.name: nelson.unittest.tuneWeights
keyword.description: Calibrate scheduling weights from measured test durations.

keyword.name: test_makeref
keyword.description: Creates a '.ref' file for a test
